rank: ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)), one-based, no interpolation; fail if rank exceeds n

diagnostic_split.method: Sort SHA256 of seed plus agreement ID, take first floor(0.7*n) as fit, remainder check
diagnostic_split.scope: Static held-back diagnostic within the selected calibration population; not time-ordered and not a prospective seizure-time test

final_fit: After the fixed diagnostic, fit the same predeclared rule on all 583 operational calibration records; no tuning based on diagnostic results
label_availability_assumption: Sold date proxies arrival; only labels strictly before May 1 are used
forward_replay_check: For each calibration seizure count prior calibration labels strictly before that seizure; require minimum_fit_records before an online calibration claim
segment_policy: One pooled correction; report segment counts and coverage descriptively, no segment-specific fitting
final_test_policy: No final-test predictions or outcomes scored
coverage_limit: Exchangeability is not established; no guaranteed per-vehicle, segment, temporal, or 36-month coverage
